description: 1. The agent must locate `/workspace/raw_data/q1_2024_sales_export.xlsx` amid distractor files. 2. Using openpyxl, it must parse the workbook's 'Q1_Sales' sheet, skip the merged banner (row 1), blank spacers (rows 2, 4, 26), column headers (row 3), the NOTE row (row 25), and the incorrect TOTALS row (row 27), and read only the 20 actual transaction rows (rows 5–24). It must normalise region names (strip whitespace, capitalize) to unify 'North', 'SOUTH', 'East', 'west' → North/South/East/West, then aggregate units sold and revenue per region. 3. Using python-docx, create `quarterly_sales_report.docx` with at least one paragraph styled as 'Heading 1' (not just bold text), a narrative paragraph mentioning Q1/2024, and an actual docx Table object containing all 4 regions with correct aggregated unit counts. 4. Using python-pptx, create `q1_2024_executive_deck.pptx` with at least 3 slides using proper Slide Layout objects, at least one slide containing a real pptx Table shape (not a text box), all 4 regions present in the deck, and numeric values that match the correctly computed aggregates — NOT the bogus 9999 TOTALS from the raw file.
